name: Precision Electronics Ltd
about: Incorporated in May 1979, Precision Electronics Ltd is a telecom infrastructure enabler with interest in infrastructure development, system integration, and manufacture and supply of high-end telecom equipment
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company designs and manufactures telecom transmission systems, military communication systems, electronic warfare systems and C4I2SR systems. Company has restructured its business segments from erstwhile Electronics & Telecom and Infra Services to Masts & Pedestals, Electro-Mechanical Manufacturing, ICT Solutions and Engineering Services
